title: Vendors paid by ACH, check or wire for 1099 review
prompt: List vendors paid this year by ACH, check or wire (not card), with totals, for 1099 review by the tax preparer, and flag vendors with no tax ID on file.

setup.q: What is the 1099 reporting threshold for the year (confirmed by the tax preparer)?

inputs.name: Vendor W-9s not stored in Dime

steps: pull the year's bill payments and bank outflows by vendor with payment method
total by vendor and apply the reporting threshold
flag vendors with no tax ID on the vendor record
write the list for the tax preparer

done.text: Every exception row cites the vendor id
1099-vendor-review.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Card payments are excluded; the threshold used is stated; filing decisions are left to the tax preparer
